groups.description: BRVO macular edema with cystoid macular edema and no serous retinal detachment on SD-OCT at baseline; treatment-naive; one intravitreal aflibercept injection, then PRN
BRVO macular edema with serous retinal detachment (all also with cystoid macular edema) on SD-OCT at baseline; treatment-naive; one intravitreal aflibercept injection, then PRN

exclusions.what: T2 BCVA (logMAR) rows No-SRD (R7) and SRD (R8): baseline, month 1, 3 and 12
exclusions.reason: Complete-case set (protocol inclusion 5; brief ruling on complete-case statements): of 52 reviewed BRVO records, the 37 analysed eyes were those that met the inclusion criteria, were monitored regularly for 12 months and provided complete data for analysis, with a minimum follow-up of 12 months (Methods, Results), equal to the last tabulated visit (Month 12); the article does not state that every treated eye completed the follow-up. No admissible series remains.
Baseline only, of the same complete-case set.

exclusions.what: T2 CMT rows (R3-R4), P-value rows (R5, R9) and column C6; T3 regression coefficients
exclusions.reason: Retinal thickness, p-values and regression coefficients are not extracted.

notes: BCVA was measured with a Snellen chart and converted to logMAR for the statistical analysis (Methods); T2 states logMAR with no Snellen row.
Visits at months 1, 2, 3, 6 and 12 after the first injection (Methods); months 2 and 6 are not tabulated.
Scatter laser photocoagulation of peripheral nonperfused areas was given 1 week after the first injection to some eyes of both groups (Results).
